instruction: Go directly from your starting position to the bedroom on the lower floor. Then go directly to the container with at least one bottle nearby, passing through exactly one floor after reaching the bedroom and before reaching the container. From there, go directly to the basket of something farthest from your starting position.

vias.name: v1
vias.label: bedroom
vias.phrase: the bedroom on the lower floor

vias.name: v2
vias.label: container
vias.phrase: the container near at least one bottle

grounded_dsl:

v1: VIA REGION 4

COUNT LEVEL 0 1 EXACTLY 1 AFTER v1 UNTIL v2
